name: Elbow pick-and-place, cell 3

ratio.note: must match the application's ratio; checked at load

referred_to.sign_convention: positive torque raises the link, matching load.gravity_angle in the application

despike.note: median rejects isolated single-step spikes; a moving average would also erase genuine short events

occupancy._note: time-occupancy ONLY; no criterion reads a peak from this

binned_below.note: everything above this went to outliers, unbinned

occupancy._cells_note: [ti, si, seconds, tau_rms, omega_mean, tau_mean]; ti=-1 marks an unbinned outlier cell

boundary._note: max torque per speed slice, from despiked samples; free to rise and fall, so neither monotone nor convex

boundary_raw._note: same scan without despiking, so the filtering is visible rather than silent

outliers.criterion: |tau| above the binning cut, or |omega| above p99
outliers._rows_note: [t_start, duration, tau_peak, omega_at_peak, tau_mean, tau_rms] per excursion; duration is what separates a drive-current event from a thermal one

duration_curve._note: highest RMS joint torque sustained over each averaging window

note: SYNTHETIC example session, generated so a fresh clone has a working envelope to run. Torque from commanded q-axis current times datasheet Kt, not a torque transducer.
